title: Ardent
style: Editorial fashion lookbook photograph for the fictional fashion house ARDENT, autumn–winter 2027 collection. Seamless paper backdrop in one flat saturated colour, hard direct flash with a crisp graphic shadow, a strong dynamic pose, fabric in motion, sharp focus, rich true colour, minimal styling, clean and modern, shot on medium format. The coloured backdrop fills the whole frame from edge to edge: no studio, light stands or paper edges in view. One model only. No text, no logos, no watermark, no props unless stated.

items.title: Cocoon Coat
items.text: Cut from one piece, it folds shut around the body like a shell.
items.prompt: A tall dark-skinned woman with a shaved head, mid-stride toward the camera in an oversized vivid cobalt-blue wool cocoon coat that swings open, black leather gloves, black pointed boots. Bone-white backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Liquid Red
items.text: Bias-cut satin that moves a beat after the body does.
items.prompt: An East Asian man with a sharp black bob, twisting with both arms raised, wearing a chili-red liquid satin shirt and matching wide trousers that ripple like water. Vivid cobalt-blue backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Butter Suit
items.text: Tone on tone: the suit and the room are the same yellow.
items.prompt: A South Asian woman with a long low ponytail, sitting sideways on a white cube with her legs crossed, in a butter-yellow double-breasted suit with exaggerated sharp shoulders. Butter-yellow backdrop, tone on tone. Full length.

items.title: Petal Collar
items.text: The collar holds its shape with nothing inside it but folds.
items.prompt: A pale woman with short copper curls, three-quarter length, in a black sculptural dress whose enormous folded collar stands up around her head like a single petal. Chili-red backdrop.

items.title: Bone Trench
items.text: A trench made to be run in, the back left open to catch the air.
items.prompt: A man with long braids running across the frame, a bone-white trench coat flaring out behind him, white trousers, bare feet. Black backdrop. Motion blur on the coat hem only. Full length.

items.title: Red Wings
items.text: Cut as a full circle, so it opens like wings when the arms go up.
items.prompt: A Latina woman with a sleek high bun, arms stretched wide, a chili-red wool cape spread open like wings over a black bodysuit. Bone-white backdrop. Full length, low camera angle.

items.title: Yellow Jump
items.text: Filled light enough to jump in.
items.prompt: A young Black man jumping high, caught mid-air with his knees tucked, in an oversized butter-yellow puffer jacket, black wide trousers and white sneakers. Vivid cobalt-blue backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Big Tuxedo
items.text: Evening tailoring, two sizes too big on purpose.
items.prompt: An androgynous model with slicked-back wet hair, crouching low on their heels, in an oversized black tuxedo worn over a sheer black mesh top, barefoot. Butter-yellow backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Slip and Leather
items.text: Soft on hard, worn off the shoulder.
items.prompt: A woman with long straight black hair walking toward the camera in a bone satin slip dress, a black leather coat slipping off her shoulders. Chili-red backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Red Utility
items.text: Workwear lines, tailored like a suit.
items.prompt: A tall woman with an afro standing wide-legged with her hands in her pockets, low camera angle, in a chili-red tailored utility jumpsuit with a wide black belt. Bone-white backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Balloon Knit
items.text: Sleeves knitted twice as wide as the arm.
items.prompt: A woman with a curly bob holding her arms in a circle above her head, in a bone mohair knit with huge balloon sleeves and a matching long knit skirt. Vivid cobalt-blue backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Leather Turn
items.text: Heavy leather that still swings.
items.prompt: A man with a shaved head turning sharply mid-step in a long black leather trench coat, the hem swinging out with slight motion blur. Chili-red backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Floor Suit
items.text: Shot from the ceiling, the suit becomes a shape on the floor.
items.prompt: Shot straight down from above: a man lying on his back on a bone-white floor with one knee up and his arms flung over his head, in a vivid cobalt-blue suit and white shirt, a hard shadow beside him.

items.title: Pleat Jump
items.text: Two hundred pleats that only open in the air.
items.prompt: A woman jumping with her legs together, a chili-red knife-pleated maxi skirt fanning out into a disc, a crisp white shirt tucked in. Butter-yellow backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Organza Wind
items.text: Sheer layers that turn into a sail in the wind.
items.prompt: A woman in layers of sheer black organza over a cobalt-blue bodysuit, the organza blown sideways by strong wind into a long sail. Bone-white backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Split Coat
items.text: Two coats joined down the middle.
items.prompt: A man standing dead straight, perfectly symmetrical, in a long coat split down the middle: the left half vivid cobalt blue, the right half chili red. Bone-white backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Satin Floor
items.text: Satin tailoring, lit so every crease shows.
items.prompt: Shot from above: a woman lying on a vivid cobalt-blue floor with her arms above her head, in a bone satin suit that catches the flash, her shadow crisp beside her.

items.title: Red Boots
items.text: Boots built for the last step of the show.
items.prompt: Very low camera angle: a woman striding over the camera in a black short-suit and glossy chili-red knee-high boots, one foot raised toward the lens. Butter-yellow backdrop.

items.title: Wind Trousers
items.text: Trousers cut so wide they move before you do.
items.prompt: A man in a cropped black jacket and enormous bone-white wide-leg trousers billowing in strong wind, standing with his feet apart. Butter-yellow backdrop. Full length.

items.title: Finale Coat
items.text: The finale: the first coat again, in red.
items.prompt: A woman laughing mid-turn with her hair flying, in a chili-red sculptural coat with a rounded cocoon silhouette. Vivid cobalt-blue backdrop. Full length, energetic finale look.
